description:
Context: withLedgerLock in packages/core/lib/ledger.mjs acquires ${target}.lock with openSync(lockPath, "wx") and writes { version, token, pid, hostname, startedAt }, but never inspects an existing lockfile for staleness when a prior writer was hard-killed.
Requirements:
1. In withLedgerLock (packages/core/lib/ledger.mjs), when openSync throws EEXIST, inspect the existing lockfile owner record and reclaim the lock if the owner is on the same host with a dead PID or its startedAt timestamp exceeds staleMs.
2. Include a clear remediation hint in the lock timeout error message telling operators to remove the lockfile if no ADLC process is running.
3. Update packages/core/index.d.ts for the optional staleMs/isPidAlive options on withLedgerLock and add unit tests in packages/core/test/core.test.mjs.
title: fix(core): reclaim stale orphaned ledger locks and add remediation hint (#621)
